title: Ilyas Shah vs Delhi Sultanate Conflict
subtitle: Delhi's campaigns failed to reverse Bengal's new sovereignty.
summary: After Bengal's unification, Sultan Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah faced Firuz Shah Tughlaq's Bengal campaign of 1353-54 and withdrew into the fort of Ekdala. A second Delhi expedition in 1359-60, after Ilyas Shah's death, again failed to secure lasting control over Bengal.
heroTagline: Mid-fourteenth-century war tested Bengal's independence from Delhi.
whyItMatters: The conflict showed that the Bengal Sultanate could survive major Delhi invasions and maintain a separate political center, shaping a durable pattern of regional sovereignty.
